title: She invested for 10 years and STOPPED — still beat him 😳

hook.big: She invested for 10 years, then STOPPED.

setup.title: Both put in $100/month. Same 7% return.
setup.foot: Anna stops after 10 years. Ben keeps going for 30.

tension.ask: So Ben wins… right? Guess again.

twist.l3: Starting early beats trying harder later.

vo.hook: She invested for just ten years, then stopped completely. He invested for thirty years straight. Guess who has more money at sixty-five?
vo.setup: Both put in one hundred dollars a month at a seven percent return. Anna invests from twenty-five to thirty-five, then stops forever. Ben starts at thirty-five and never stops.
vo.tension: Here's the thing. Anna only put in twelve thousand dollars total. Ben put in thirty-six thousand. Three times more. So Ben wins, right? Guess again.
vo.reveal: At sixty-five, Anna has about one hundred and forty thousand dollars. Ben has about one hundred and twenty-two thousand. Anna wins, with way less money in.
vo.twist: Anna invested three times less than Ben, and still ended up with more. That's the power of starting early. Run it yourself. Free calculator on wealthdelay dot com. Link's right below.

disclaimer: Hypothetical: $100/month at a 7% average annual return, compounded monthly. Not financial advice — real returns vary.
